## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change.

## Verification

List commands and observable checks. Mark each result `PASS`, `FAIL`, or `NOT VERIFIED`.

- [ ] Frontend tests and build
- [ ] Go tests, vet, and module verification (if server code changed)
- [ ] Rust format/check/tests (if native code changed)
- [ ] Deployment or configuration validation (if deployment files changed)
- [ ] Third-party inventory refreshed and reviewed (if dependencies, images, or actions changed)

## Security and privacy

- [ ] Authorization, expiry, input validation, rate limits, and release behavior were reviewed where relevant.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, screen contents, input contents, or private identifiers are included.
- [ ] Supported behavior and remaining limitations are documented accurately.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe protocol, deployment, migration, platform, or user-documentation impacts.

## Licensing

List new dependencies, assets, or copied material and their license/provenance evidence. Do not add license grants or assume a project license has been selected.
